title: TransactionRequestEnvelope
description: Inbound request crossing TB1 into the provider broker. Caller identity is mandatory; identity-less envelopes are rejected. Backwards compatibility: additive minor versions only; breaking changes create v2. v1.1 (protocol v0.4, additive): payload.kind distinguishes evm_transaction (default, absent = v0.3-shaped clients unaffected) from typed_data (eth_signTypedData_v4) and personal_message (personal_sign) signature-only requests, carried via the new optional typed_data_json/message_hex fields. payload.to is no longer required (typed_data/personal_message have no `to`); evm_transaction payloads are unaffected since they still always send it.

request_id.description: Stable ID for the whole lifecycle

protocol_version.description: browser-connect protocol version, when arriving via a browser broker

caller.description: Mandatory caller identity. Empty origin AND empty app_id is invalid.

origin.description: dapp origin URL or local caller URI

access.description: declared access class; signing requests traverse the full pipeline

payload.description: EVM transaction fields (raw request; decoding happens downstream) for kind=evm_transaction, or a typed_data/personal_message signature payload (v1.1, protocol v0.4).

to.description: evm_transaction only; null = contract creation (evaluated and explicitly creation)

value_wei.description: decimal string; absent = 0 not assumed, treated as not provided and defaulted to "0" only at validation with an audit note

typed_data_json.description: required iff kind=typed_data: the full eth_signTypedData_v4 JSON payload

message_hex.description: required iff kind=personal_message: the raw message bytes, 0x-hex
